The smallest defensible next step is one verified completion or justified close with dated ownership, validation, rollback, release/security, attribution, measurement, and deduplication evidence.

Continue the existing parked-site readiness packets only. Keep the scaffold properties parked, private, and preview-only. Preserve unknowns and do not build, publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize, spend, add dependencies, or create queue entries.

Continue the existing private launch and security gates. Keep the gated product private and preview-only; do not send rights outreach, expose it publicly, expand alerts, deploy, change credentials or configuration, add dependencies, or claim clearance without the required evidence and human-counsel review.

Continue the existing period-aligned finance reconciliation only. Preserve the 2026-09-21 provider result as aggregate and unattributed; keep matching-period costs, budgets, margin, ROI, payback, forecasts, and cost-to-learn unknown.
